Method of Attack: Bundling a tainted version of the AnyDesk Remote Desktop utility
Base64-obfuscated code to launch a malicious executable
Attack Vector: Malicious npm packages mimicking legitimate libraries
Indicators of Compromise: dataset.db (Windows executable disguised as a database file)
Google folder created in APPDATA path
AnyDesk executable signed with compromised philandro Software GmBH certificate (April 7, 2020)
